items.qualificationNote: General guide. Check the post code and qualification in the official notification for the recruitment year.

items.title: Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSL)
items.description: 10+2 recruitment for clerical and data-entry posts.

roles: Lower Division Clerk / Junior Secretariat Assistant
items.qualificationNote: Verified against the 2025 CHSL notice, paragraph 8. This is a dated qualification reference.
